slides.title: THE CHAIN RULE, STEP BY STEP
THE RULE
slides.note: Differentiate the outer function, keep the inside, then multiply by the derivative of the inside.

slides.title: WATCH OUT
points: Do not forget to multiply by the derivative of the inside.
Leave the inside function unchanged when you differentiate the outside.
